Tarnwick TG-7 Field Gateway
2 Status lights
The gateway accepts 12 to 48 V DC on the screw terminal block. Typical consumption is 4 W, rising to 7 W while the cellular modem transmits.
TG-7 administrator guide, release 4.1, page 1
1 Power
Administrator guide, release 4.1. The TG-7 collects readings from up to 64 Modbus sensors and forwards them to a central server over cellular or Ethernet backhaul.
3 Sensor bus
A sensor that misses 3 polls in a row is marked offline and raises event 204 in the event log.
The gateway prefers Ethernet when a cable is connected and falls back to cellular after 60 seconds without a link. Readings are buffered on the gateway for up to 72 hours while both links are down.
Connect sensors to the RS-485 terminals A, B and GND in a daisy chain. Fit the 120 ohm termination jumper J4 on the gateway if it sits at one end of the bus.
3.1 Polling
The gateway polls every sensor once per polling interval. The default interval is 30 seconds and the shortest allowed interval is 5 seconds.
4 Backhaul
The default serial settings are 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity and 1 stop bit.
TG-7 administrator guide, release 4.1, page 2
5 Firmware updates
The gateway keeps the previous firmware in a second slot. If the new image fails to boot three times, the gateway rolls back to the previous image automatically.

Download the signed firmware image to a USB drive formatted as FAT32. Insert the drive, open Maintenance, then Update, and select the image. Do not remove power during the update, which takes about 4 minutes.
TG-7 administrator guide, release 4.1, page 3
Certificates for the server connection are rotated every 90 days. The gateway sends a warning to the server 14 days before a certificate expires.
Remote shell access is disabled by default. Enable it under Security, then Remote access, and it switches itself off again after 8 hours.
6 Security
Change the default administrator password on first login. Passwords must be at least 12 characters and are stored as salted hashes.
TG-7 administrator guide, release 4.1, page 4
